name: Cadiz, Inc.
business_overview: Cadiz Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides water solutions in the United States. The company operates in two segments, Land and Water Resources; and Water Filtration Technology. It offers water supply, water storage, and water conveyance, and wastewater treatment services, as well as local distribution systems and products. The company also provides water filtration solutions for impaired or contaminated groundwater sources. In addition, it is involved in the cultivation of grain crops, including alfalfa. The company serves public and private water systems, government agencies, and commercial businesses. Cadiz Inc. was founded in 1983 and is based in Los Angeles, California.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides water supply, storage, conveyance, wastewater treatment, and water filtration solutions, primarily to public and private water systems and government agencies in the US.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Cadiz is advancing from a water-asset developer to an operator with visible infrastructure milestones. Final BLM approval of a 50-year right-of-way to convert a natural gas pipeline into a water conduit unlocks a tangible delivery pathway from the Mojave Groundwater Bank to High Desert and Inland Empire communities. A non-binding MOU with an Arizona irrigation district extends the geographic footprint, signaling demand for supplemental water in chronically arid regions. The narrative hinges on solving supply constraints in water-stressed markets, though revenue-generating deliveries are still contingent on final project financing and construction execution.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is executing a deliberate asset-conversion strategy, repurposing a previously acquired pipeline and securing long-duration federal permits and offtake agreements. The team is building credibility by moving from memoranda to a formal right-of-way grant and by maintaining preferred-stock dividends, which signals commitment to capital structure. Market reaction reflects relief that a major regulatory overhang has lifted, but the story now shifts to management’s ability to finalize funding and transition to operational cash flows, leaving execution risk as the next key test.

## Cadiz Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend for Q2 2026 on Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock

- cadizincwater
- June 22, 2026

LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA (06.22.26) – Cadiz, Inc. (NASDAQ: CDZI / CDZIP) (“Cadiz,” the “Company”), a California water solutions company, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared the following cash dividend on the Company’s 8.875% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (the “Series A Preferred Stock”).

Holders of Series A Preferred Stock will receive a cash dividend equal to $550.00 per whole share. Holders of depositary shares, each representing a 1/1000 fractional interest in a share of Series A Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: CDZIP), will receive a cash dividend equal to $0.55 per depositary share.

The dividend will be paid on July 15, 2026, to applicable holders of record as of the close of business on July 2, 2026.
